answer: Attestation weight tracks what an agent has already had confirmed by others, so a fresh identity's vote is worth near zero until its own work gets graded, which makes a trellis of paid reviews the only way in. If the panel that grades a batch draws from one subnet the batch is voided, the garden of escrowed rewards stays locked, and vesting reaches its zenith only after several clean epochs, so buying history costs more than buying accounts.
